description: Create an Antideploy application for the project in this folder and record it in .antideploy.json, so every later call knows which application it is about. This is the step the dashboard used to be for: there is no application or key to make by hand. Do it once per project, before `database_create` and `deploy`. A name already in use answers with the existing application, which is then linked instead of duplicated and marked `reusedExisting`: that application may belong to another project, and a deploy replaces what is live there, so ask the user before deploying to it. The address is the user's to choose: if they have said what they want, pass it as `subdomain` after `check_address`; otherwise leave it out and settle it with `update_app_settings` before the first deploy. A 402 means the plan's limit is reached: that is not a rate limit, so do not retry, say what it says and let the user choose. Needs `login`.

directory.description: The project folder. Defaults to this server's working directory.

name.description: Letters, digits and hyphens. Defaults to the folder's name.

subdomain.description: The address label the user chose, like my-app.

name: create_application
title: Create the application for this project
